messages:
Maya: Quick sync — marketing planning pub announce for Optimize v0.9 next Wed 09:00 PT. Need final changelog permalink, docs landing with tracking, a single p95 latency stat + token-cost delta, and a two-sentence blurb for socials by EOD Tue. Also confirm press embargo timing (we have a 09:00 PT embargo). Can eng/docs confirm ownership?
Sanjay: Ill own the changelog URL. PR merged to main but won't create the public permalink until docs are live. Current ref: https://github.com/redwood-inference/changelog/pull/412. Plan: post permalink here immediately after docs publish.
Liam: Docs team will publish the Optimize guide today. ETA Tue 14:00 PT for canonical URL. We'll append the marketing utm param (?utm_campaign=optimize_v0.9) on handoff.
Olivia: Rollout plan from infra: canary starts 09:00 PT in us-west, 30m observe, then progressive ramp to 100% at ~09:30 PT. Canary will be reachable publicly (to match screenshots) but capacity-limited. If press needs GA at 09:00, we can expose the canary endpoint.
Maya: Two asks on rollout: 1) confirm canary UX parity so screenshots match live; 2) can you provide p95 numbers ASAP after canary starts?
Olivia: Canary runs identical code path (no feature gating). We'll capture and post p50/p95/p99 traces during the window.
Samir: I'll snapshot p95 directly from the telemetry dashboard and export the 7-day baseline vs v0.9 CSV for the blog/chart. ETA Tue 15:00 for attachments.
Priya: Webinar status: Thu 10:00 PT is locked. Landing page exists but needs the product blurb + CTA. We want form submissions routed to SDR queue inbound-launch-optimize and attributed to campaign optimize_v0.9. Please ensure the webhook payload includes the exact tag value so routing works. Example payload SDR expects: 
```
{
  "source": "web-forms",
  "campaign": "optimize_v0.9",
  "tag": "optimize-launch",
  "route_to": "sdr-inbound/optimize"
}
```
Sanjay: Confirmed. We'll add campaign and tag fields verbatim and include the utm param on the docs link. I'll coordinate the schema change with release-bot so the deploy contains the event update.
Nora: Legal/PR note: press embargo is 09:00 PT. Please ensure we don't leak URLs before that. Marketing will hold scheduling until you post the changelog/docs link in this thread.
Maya: Understood — we'll schedule the tweet for Wed 09:05 PT but will only publish after this channel has the official links.
release-bot: Deploy scheduled: optimize/service v0.9 -> canary us-west @ 2025-11-12T09:00:00-08:00; full rollout @ 2025-11-12T09:30:00-08:00. CI: green.
Samir: Once canary is live I'll post: 1) p95 screenshot (png), 2) baseline_vs_v0.9.csv, 3) a quick bullet with the cost-delta (tokens/op) summary for the blog.
Liam: Docs URL (canonical) will be: https://docs.redwood.ai/optimize/v0.9 — I'll post the final handoff link with ?utm_campaign=optimize_v0.9 appended here when live.
Maya: Final marketing checklist for this thread: changelog URL, docs URL with utm, a 1-2 sentence blurb for the tweet, p95 screenshot + CSV, and confirmation of SDR webhook payload. Please post all in this thread once ready; we'll queue the announcement and the webinar CTA after that. :rocket:
Priya: SDR ops: when webhook lands, please set tag="optimize-launch" and priority=P2. I'll validate routing on first hit and report back.
Sanjay: Will post final changelog permalink + two-sentence social blurb in this thread Tue 14:10 PT after docs publish.
Maya: Thanks all — small follow-up: designer needs the CSV by Tue 15:00 so they can mock the chart for the blog. Samir, can you confirm?
Samir: Confirmed — CSV + p95 screenshot posted by Tue 15:00 here. If anything slips Ill call out immediately.
Olivia: We'll monitor the canary and notify this channel within the 30m window if any latency or error-rate regressions show up. Rollback plan ready.
Maya: Perfect. Once we have links + blurb I'll schedule the social cadence and share the asset folder. Thanks! :thumbsup:
